reviews.text:
Excellent pet health check.
It was very thorough and informative.
All of the staff here are so helpful and friendly.  They have looked after my pets for at least the past 10 years and I trust them to do a great job every time!
Visited 2 of Manor vet’s branches in the last year and they have been great during every interaction. Very helpful.
Helpful in answering my worries. Treated my pet with kindness and we went away happy
Thanks for the 5* Review Chris
Health check for our Cat Cassian. Very friendly staff at reception and the Nurse was superb handling our nervous moggy with care and sensitivity. Highly recommend Manor Vets
Staff very helpful. But found it very expensive .
Great vets friendly and knowledgeable

I'm a first time dog owner and it was my adopted dog's first visit to the vet with me for a check up. I was extremely impressed with the way the vet handled my dog. I had quite a few questions and he was extremely patient and kind. I think we kept him over our appointment slot (being our first time) but he did not rush us and dud a thorough check. Nothing was too much trouble, he was so gentle with my dog and gave clear instructions. I was very impressed and would highly recommend this practice.
Thanks for the review Marie
Emergency appt - super helpful and fantastic friendly staff. Couldn’t fault the service or kindness.

Took our dog as he had an upset stomach. Received our appointment the same day.
Excellent service & vets surgery very clean and welcoming.
Staff very helpful and spoke to me very nicely 👌 …

Reception staff very friendly & helpful. Found all the vets there to be sensitive, approachable & easy to talk to. Demonstrate a caring attitude & very thorough, explaining what options for treating your pet are available clearly.
These vets and staff care about your pets highly recommended
Very polite and patient service I didn’t realise they closed early on a Saturday and the receptionists were very patient with me which I do appreciate , the vet also handled my cat very well.

I could not fault the fast, caring response I received when my dog had potentially, swallowed part of a stick, and although was not obviously in distress, she was very subdued, refusing food and water and definitely not herself.They made me an appointment for that morning but then I was asked to come straight to the vets to be triaged, which was a huge relief to me. She was examined by a vetinary nurse who confirmed she was in no immediate danger, so I could wait for my appointment there, or go and come back. I decided to walk my dog around locally and then come back. After only 10 minutes I got a call to say they'd had a cancellation, so could see my dog straight away. The vet was thorough in her examination and and discovered a piece of wood lodged in between my dog's back teeth which had also rubbed her tongue sore. The vet and nurse were able to remove it and prescribe pain killing medication. I could see immediately that my dog was ok. Everything had lifted and she was 'back' The service was so efficient, I would recommend  to everyone who needs a vet to go to! 👌
Staff are very kind and helpful Vet explains everything so good visit
Always good service friendly and professional

Cannot fault Manor Vets. Friendly, welcoming and explains everything (including costs) very clearly. Quick appointments, lots of attention given to Ruby to relax her. Best thing we did moving to Manor.

You was absolutely fantastic to the time I phoned to the time you seen my cat misty and how well you treated her I will be ever grateful for the short notice to see her and the medication to treat her seems loads better this morning thank you to all the staff
I am starting to reconsider my pet plan with Manir pets..... I'll leave it at that.
Scruff is always treated with care and her needs are always met nice friendly atmosphere
Lovely staff there, always really helpful and caring
I took my pup for his first vaccination the staff and vet were lovely,they answered all my questions nothing was too much trouble

Always great service, very gentle but thorough examinations and treatment.  Full information and options given for both of our cats and .... No pressure selling !!

I have complete trust in Manor Vets Northfield and wouldn't go anywhere else x
Staff very caring and kind.

Olive had her first kitten vaccination. It was easy to organise with Manor Vets and we opted for the kitten package. It includes both vaccinations, flea and worm treatment, microchip and a large bag of dried food. £100 for the package. I priced this separately and £100 is definitely a good offer.
The vet was brilliant with Olive. I expected Olive to struggle and cry but the vaccination was given so smoothly, she didn't even flinch.
The staff are welcoming and reassuring.
Olive had a positive first experience at Manor Vets.
I was happily with the service I got .

The receptionist (becky) is always so lovely over the phone & in person always try to accommodate where possible and the vets surgery is always clean and the staff are welcoming and always have you pets best interests at heart

I can't thank the team enough for the care they gave my dog. We were seen quickly, and the vet was thorough and reassuring throughout the appointment. They carefully examined his eye, explained what they were doing, and made sure I understood the treatment plan.

The medication has already made a noticeable difference, and I really appreciated how kind and patient everyone was. It's clear that they genuinely care about the animals they treat and the owners who bring them in.

Excellent service, professional care, and a friendly team. I wouldn't hesitate to recommend this practice to others.

This was my first visit to Manor Vets at Northfield and I was very impressed.
My dog is very scared at the vets and as a Staffy can seem a ‘bad dog’ and I have been made to feel that was at other vets. Not here though, the vet was kind, caring and thorough  and the nurse who assisted was excellent also whilst he was being examined.
Everything was clearly explained and my questions answered.
I would definitely recommend this vet.

Staff were polite, friendly and efficient. I had my little Moose in for an operation and from the day of the op to the check up they were very professional and showed great care with my pet.
I would recommend 10/10
Very friendly service. No rushing.
Amazing job neutering my male cat

Lovely and kind staff at Manor vets, Northfield. Always efficient service from the reception team. All the vets are very proffessional and will always offer a reassurring  word.
The reception is always lovely and clean and I always appreciate the reminder text and messages that are sent to me.
Thank you for taking care of my little fur baby.
Absolutely wonderful team, everyone was extremely helpful and kind.
Very helpful and accommodating

Called manor vets today as I brought a new puppy and they were brilliant from start to finish so professional and helpful kara the vet was brilliant so friendly and knowledgeable can see she loves her job thankyou so much cannot wait to bring dusty in again

Saw my very ill elderly dog at a moments notice when my own vet wouldn't see us until next day. The vet Daniel gave my 13 year old dog the time and space to examine her without a muzzle. As she is extremely nervous  and timid this is the first full examination she has ever had. Well done Daniel and thank you for helping and being patient with Mollie
The staff. Are great very friendly  the grill that took Lola of me was fab then. She bought her back over all these staff are very friendly and there to help
Kara the vet treated our unwell cat, we were seen on time and with respect.
Excellent caring Vets, Nurses and Staff.  Highly recommended.
Every fur baby we have had at manor vets as been well looked after and we wouldn’t trust anywhere else thank you manor vets ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

We have been with Manor Vets for at least 12 years. The staff, Vets, nurses and reception are without a doubt, professional, knowledgeable and make time to talk and discuss things. It is a pleasant and clean  reception area and consulting rooms are always cleaned after each consultation. They will also do direct insurance claims with PetPlan. I think there may be a lower level that they will not do the direct claims for, but a quick call or chat could clear that up straight away. We hope to be with them for many more years. They also have other surgeries around the area. Out of hours calls are redirected to the new Blaise Hospital on Bristol Road South.Manor Vets
Highly recommend. Very nice staff, professional and friendly.

I have never had a bad experience with this vets. My beautiful pets are well looked after and all staff from.the moment you walk into the reception are respectful, welcoming and so helpful. The advice given is always professional and decisions made are always supportive.

Always been good with my cats even when my 5 week old kitten needed to see the vet they was great but u dont see many vets take on such tiny babies and ive had my 5 week old since 1 day old but these have been amazing
Have been going for a number of years now and always found the team extremely friendly, helpful and professional. I know my pet is in safe hands and wouldn’t go anywhere else.

Manor Vets are just incredible and I wouldn't go anywhere else with my pets. From the friendly and welcoming reception staff to the vets who genuinely take time to ensure you understand what they're saying, the options available to you and next steps. I always feel the treatment they suggest is appropriate and they give a good range of options where they can.
Really great practice, warm and friendly vibe and a great place to meet fellow fur baby lovers. Highly recommended, they also offer a great pet club offer. Miguel the kitten was not one bit nervous.
Friendly, welcoming and informative staff.
Very friendly and helpful gave good advice for what may be better for me pet in the future
Great vets really helpful.
Great vets staff very friendly and look after your pet well.
I thought it was lovely and my cat amber was well looked after x

I have been very happy with the annual check up and treatments for my cat since moving to Manor Vets Northfield. There’s a payment plan which helps to spread the cost over the year. There’s a payment staff are genuinely interested in the individual personalities of the pets and taylor their approach accordingly.
Good local vet, but pricing for pet prescriptions & medicines expensive.
Very kinds and friendly vet and made ypu feel welcome
Will always recommend manor for their care and consideration of animals
The staff are efficient and knowledgeable. Very friendly and helpful. The visit was very reassuring.

Always very understanding and helpful. Isabel is a fantastic vet honestly such a helpful, lovely person and I can say that I've seen a few other vets here too and never had any issues my cats are always well cared for here .
Thank you for all the kindness and care you have provided over the years that we have been bringing our beloved dog Ollie to you and especialy today following his passing.
Always a good service and understanding said goodbye to a 14 year old yorkie there very understanding sent us a card totks
Very good service
Fully recommend Manor Vet, Japer and Smokie were made so welcome.  The environment was calming and the staff super friendly and helpful.
Wonderful surgery. Really care about the furbabies. Staff are always caring and helpful. Have been going for 11 years now. Never a bad visit

You wait till I get onto the phone to you lot tomorrow morning, getting my dog cremated WITHOUT my permission, disposed of his ashes when I wanted them back ! DISGUSTING! Just to clarify to everyone… I did NOT sign anything, I did NOT make any payment other than payment to have him cremated and receive his ashes back, which they happily took my money, when he had already been cremated over a week ago !

We can’t thank Manor Vets enough for the care and compassion they showed towards our beloved cat, Jerry. From the moment we walked in, the whole team were kind, supportive, and understanding. They not only looked after Jerry with such professionalism, but also supported us as owners through a very difficult time.

Receiving a sympathy card and forget-me-not seeds after his passing was such a touching and thoughtful gesture, and it meant so much to us. It shows just how much they truly care about the animals and families they look after.

Thank you to everyone at Manor Vets for your kindness – it will never be forgotten.

I've left you a funny photo of Jerry one that always makes us smile :)

Always friendly, helpful and caring, whichever branch we attend. Parking at Northfield can be difficult, but otherwise, would highly recommend Manor Vets to anyone.  It's a shame they have farmed out their out-of-hours emergency service however - £300 just to walk through the door at the animal hospital, which I believe is very likely to cause suffering and distress to both pets and their humans due to inability to pay the exorbitant up-front cost. This was a centralised decision I believe however, and no reflection on the fab vets and staff at the Practice.

Superb vets, my dog was very unwell. He was seen at extreme short notice and the help and service was second to none.
Thank you very much.
Kara came out to see George in the car due to recent seizure in the waiting area, she is very professional and caring to suit his needs,  also the reception staff are all lovely and friendly!

Hi chech dog don't have to go for another year as long as she ok
Thanks Caroline
Staff good

I cannot recommend this vet clinic enough. The whole team is kind, professional and genuinely cares about the animals. They always take the time to explain everything clearly and make both me and my dog Lucy feel at ease. The care here is top quality and I always know my pet is in safe hands. So grateful to have found such a wonderful clinic!

My cat has been neutered and had a small incision due to a complication. When I picked him up, the nurse let him go home with the canulla attached to his leg so obviously the nurse didn’t check before discharged him. Extremely unhappy after this incident. And yes, they do charge a lot, but definitely not worth it.
Great place   friendly and welcoming

Until recently we had not had cause to complain about the service we have received, apart from the prices. For over a month now our cat has had Diarrhoea, we have paid over £500 to try and find out what’s wrong, the treatments and advice we have received haven’t worked, culminating in bloods being taken, we were told we would get the results in 7 days, we didn’t get them, the vet who took the bloods doesn’t work weekends and apparently doesn’t work Mondays!!, so we are going to be stressing all weekend and into next week. Disgusting customer service!!!.
Lovely friendly caring team nothing to much trouble for them worth visiting

My cat keep vomiting for 3 days at least 10 times we had no choice but call the vet , luckily got a place at once. the vet exam him in details and he is fine , lovely staff and very clean everywhere. Will stick with this vet for sure .
A caring, professional service and you feel your concerns are listened too.

The parking is horrendous & the prices for boosters is very expensive how can it cost £70 to vaccinate my teapot chiaua & it's the same price for my 10kg dog. These prices can't keep rising at this rate
Excellent service
Had appointment on wed on time pleasant staff very polite covid safe and clean.
Exceptional level of care and communication after an emergency with my cat, so grateful for the whole team

Took a while to be able to register after I've moved but been really helpful since then.

Only had to go for routine appointments but always kind friendly staff.

Disabled wheelchair access is a little limited through the reception and access to consulting rooms due to a wide chair.

Always felt that Manor vets was supporting and Super vets . Not impressed with Northfield , the vets are excellent and supporting as always. Not much appreciation for reception service , not even a smile when paying the bill . Charges are a lot higher now and although I was served didn't feel the warm service as that of the Halesowen branch. Also very unhappy with closure of Halesowen branch on a Sunday as this is forcing pet owners to pay out of hours fees!! At blaze super hospital . Feeling a bit let down ..
Everybody is so welcoming and they make you feel at ease, they are very professional and friendly at the same time, thank you :)
Always friendly, the vet is amazing, she explains everything in details, so knowledgeable and great with our dog. Couldn't be happier!
